R11 R62: basisRefusals answers each refusal of a real promote of a bad basis, with its check, and nothing written
R20 R21 R22: disposeAct answers the real dispose over a real selection: done, an unknown selection, another owner's
R49: migratedSurfacing answers the surfacing a migration replay recorded, and null for a question made on this plane
R33 R65: readRefusals answers NOT_AN_INQUIRY for a bundle that is no question, and one NO_SUCH_BUNDLE for an absent id and for a question the viewer may not see
R55: datedWaitOf answers the setter's dated wait due from its local day in the zone, waiting a second before it, and none to admin; parameterised by viewer and date
R55 R58: questionWaitsSetAside answers the asker the set-aside wait with by and reason, the restore ending it with both in the history, and nothing to a viewer who may not see the document
R23 R25: divideAnswers answers the real division (divided, its children and apportionment) and each refusal a screen builds by hand, as inquiry gives it
R23 R25 (catalogue): each divide refusal that carries a row carries the row inquiry-grammar holds for its code
R27 R85: groundAnswers answers the real partition (authored, restructured) and each refusal a screen builds by hand, and writes nothing on a refusal
R55 R58: questionWaitsNone answers a visible question with no wait as the real read gives it, nothing to add
fixtures.mjs (new fixtures): two calls give two answers, each over a world of its own, never a stored one
